column1: # s1d.tsv -- the mutations base#1464 (config-gen S1d, the host mutation

# report PINNED. One row per behaviour:

column4: sed -i '/refusing rather than reporting no change"$/{n;s/exit 1/exit 2/}' script/test/config_gen_mutation_targets.sh
sed -i 's%^  if \[\[ -L "\${out}" \]\].*; then$%  if false; then%' script/test/config_gen_mutation_targets.sh
sed -i 's%^    if ! git -C "\${repo}" diff --quiet "\${base}" -- "\${_CGM_MOD}" \\$%    if false \\%' script/test/config_gen_mutation_targets.sh
sed -i 's%^  for st in "\${f\[@\]}"; do$%  for st in; do%' script/test/config_gen_mutation_targets.sh
sed -i 's%^  if ! mv -T "\${tmp}" "\${out}"; then%  [[ -z "${old}" ]] || rm -rf "${old}"; if ! mv -T "${tmp}" "${out}"; then%' script/test/config_gen_mutation_targets.sh
sed -i 's%^  if ! mv -T "\${tmp}" "\${out}"; then%  mv -T "${tmp}" "${out}"; if false; then%' script/test/config_gen_mutation_targets.sh

sed -i 's%^    _cgm_publish_failed install no "out=\${out}" "backup=\${old}/o"$%    rm -rf "${old}"; _cgm_publish_failed install no "out=${out}" "backup=${old}/o"%' script/test/config_gen_mutation_targets.sh
